# Test Fixtures

This directory contains sample images and data for testing.

## Files

- `sample_clothing.jpg` - Sample clothing item image (from Amazon Fashion dataset)
- `sample_face.jpg` - Sample face photo for try-on testing (TO BE ADDED)
- `sample_body.jpg` - Sample full-body photo for try-on testing (TO BE ADDED)

## Adding Test Images

For real AI API testing, you need to add:
1. A face photo (`sample_face.jpg`) - 512x512 or 1024x1024, clear frontal face
2. A body photo (`sample_body.jpg`) - 1024x1024, full body, standing straight

These images should be appropriate for testing and not contain sensitive personal information.
